## Largest measured excesses

No available measured excess. Collect explicit matched work, control rates, clocks and compiler-retention evidence before ranking investigations.

## Limitations

- Three iterations establish within-job repeatability only. No universal regression budget is assigned.
- Linux Vulkan and Windows D3D11 are separate series. No cross-backend deltas are implied.
- Missing references remain ModelIncomplete. Unsupported compiler counters remain unavailable. Logical payload is not exact off-chip traffic.
- Actual billed minutes are supplied by the operator. Elapsed-time estimates and native accounting remain distinct in provenance.
- [#1547](https://github.com/APKiwiOrg/KhaozEngine/issues/1547) remains the partial-write accounting proof limit. Successful publication does not close it.
- Optimization, vendor profiling, Windows Vulkan, consumer assets and equipment fit, adoption and release require separate work and approval.
- Original registered files in the linked workflow run remain the reproduction authority. Verification ends when its retained handles close.
